attributes.title: phase4_alarm_probe
attributes.description: CI-only Phase 4 characterization probe. Builds a disposable Alarm fixture, activates it, and measures system.alarm.queryStatus matching semantics, cardinality and cost for exact Alarm paths.

parameters.name: providerRoot
parameters.description: Tag provider root that owns the disposable Alarm fixture, for example [default].

parameters.name: rootName
parameters.description: Run-unique folder created under the provider root for the Alarm fixture.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider name used when building qualified source-path patterns.

parameters.name: noiseCount
parameters.description: Number of additional active Alarms created outside the measured paths.

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Number of activate/clear cycles run against one exact Alarm path without acknowledgement.

parameters.name: repeats
parameters.description: Number of timed repetitions per query form.

parameters.name: ackUsername
parameters.description: Explicit Gateway-scope acknowledgement username used by the acknowledge measurement.
